description: Hand-written recording (spec §9 replay format; no model key was available to record live with RECORD=1) for Business M5, the Shanghai pizzeria owner. Turn 1: 'Will we run out of anything tomorrow?' → get_inventory + forecast_stock (400 boxes short by the end of tomorrow; suggestion 4 packs of BOX-33CM-100 from the verified supplier, which becomes payee_1, the first placeholder of the conversation). Turn 2: 'Order boxes from the usual supplier' → propose_purchase_order with payee_1 and the suggested packs; the server reads the price from the supplier's structured catalog and writes a DRAFT purchase order only (no proposal, approval or payment). The owner signs it with the payments passkey in Orders.

turns.userText: Will we run out of anything tomorrow?

steps.text: Let me check your stock and tomorrow's forecast.

Yes: pizza boxes. You will be 400 boxes short by the end of tomorrow (need for today and tomorrow plus safety stock, minus what is on hand). Everything else is covered. I suggest 4 packs of 100 boxes (BOX-33CM-100) from your verified supplier payee_1, CNY 180 per pack, CNY 720 in total, delivered by tomorrow. Say "order boxes" and I will draft the purchase order for you to sign.

turns.userText: Order boxes from the usual supplier

steps.text: I drafted a purchase order to payee_1: 4 packs of 100 pizza boxes at the catalog price, CNY 720. Nothing is ordered or paid yet. Review and sign it with your passkey in Orders; the supplier's invoice is then checked against what you signed and paid only after your approval.
